services.name: Shark Fishing
services.desc: We are proud to offer light tackle action inshore fishing charters for Bass, Bluefish, Cod, Mackerel, and Pollock. Captain Ben recommends 4-6 hour trips for inshore fishing but we can customize the trip based on your needs. Much like Family trips, these are usually within 5 miles of the coast offering calmer waters and protection from the coastline on windier days. The primary difference between family trips and inshore trips is that you will fish for a longer time and target bigger fish. Instead of dropping baits to the bottom and drifting to target smaller fish you are more likely to be casting live baits or using chunk baits. On inshore fishing trips, Captain Ben will typically anchor up

services.name: Ocean Cruises
services.desc: Enjoy a Beautiful sunset ocean cruise aboard the Kristin K. Bring some friends and grab some dinner while cruising around in Casco Bay and surrounding areas. Maybe you would like to see some of the islands on the Bay on a Scenic Island Tour. Or maybe you would like to see the many beautiful lighthouses and historic landmarks on the coast. Perhaps you want Captain Ben to look for wildlife such as seals and porpoise and whales. Let us know what interests you and Captain Ben can put together a wonderful evening cruise for you. We look forward to getting you out on the water to enjoy some of Maine’s Finest! Captain Ben is a family man himself. Which is why he offers a low-cost 2 hour family fun

blurb: Guests can fish for species like Shark, Sea Bass, Cod, Bluefish, Mackerel, Haddock, and Pollock on various fishing trips including family, inshore, ground, and shark fishing. Ocean cruises and tours include seal and whale watching, dinner and sunset cruises, and scenic island tours. Captain Ben offers trips suitable for families, beginners, and experienced anglers.

quotes.text: Captain Ben of Kristen K Charters was absolutely outstanding. Professional, incredibly friendly, patient, and extremely knowledgeable about the waters and every species we were targeting. The boat was spotless, safe, and equipped with top-of-the-line gear. He made the entire trip fun and accommodating for everyone in our group. Truly an amazing friends and family experience, and we would absolutely fish with Captain Ben again. Highly recommend booking a trip with him!

I booked a trip with Captain Ben for my nephew's 11th birthday, and everyone had a wonderful time. The inshore fishing trip was perfect since my nephew and I both tend to get sea sick. Neither of us had any issues, and all four of us on the trip caught fish. I highly recommend booking Captain Ben, and I would love to do another trip with him on the Kristin K.

quotes.author: W. Husarek
quotes.text: We went on a half day fishing trip with Kristin K and Captain Ben and what a great time! Our party had two adults and two younger teenagers. Captain Ben was accommodating to everyone, knew where the fish were and very attentive. Captain Ben ensured everyone had a great time. We are already scheduled again this year. I can’t say enough positive!! Thank You!!!

quotes.author: S. Henry
quotes.text: First of all I would to start off by saying we had an awesome experience fishing with captain Ben, he was extremely professional as well as being friendly and knowledgeable. We caught a bunch of fish, but even if we would no have caught anything this would have still been a great experience. I would recommend Kristin K Charters to anyone.

We had an outstanding afternoon fishing! We booked two boats for a team-building outing and it went great. Out on the water, the experience was a perfect mix of relaxing and engaging. Everyone came away talking about how great it way. Highly recommended for both corporate group or anyone looking for a memorable day on the water.

Captain Ben is by far the best! We've been out on his boat multiple times over the years with our kids and friends. He's attentive to each and every client young or old and does a fantastic job making sure you have what you need to make your shark or fishing trip successful. I highly recommend him for your next or new memories!
